idea: Lightweight presenting tool with functionality like Hedgedoc. Slides are created using markdown.
features:
Three different types of previews: editor, preview and side-by-side.
Full text markdown editor which rich features like colors codes, text effects, headlines, url embeddings and such. It should also contain complex implementations like font-color gradients (text has gradient as color) or basic animations for text motion.
Plan the implementation of what markdown derivative to use for the features asked. Since the features asked for this project are pretty complex, even take into account if creating a new derivate for this project is worth it.
Animations are motion styles applied to text elements and or other assets. For example a text bouncing in or appearing letter by letter is an animation. These animations can be pretty basic and need (currently) no complex frame editor. The goal is simply to smooth the transitions by bringing in movement. Think about how to implement a way to hide specific elements the user marked so they can appear one after another when the user is presenting.
Pages are controlled by a single markdown file the user edits. The start of the markdown file controls the setting of the visual style of the pages. Settings should contain keywords like "style" or "animation". Plan which settings are useful and what to implement. These settings should also be present in the text-editor as selectables. The content of the page needs to be between three equal signs === Every content between these equal signs is an own page.
Make sure the content entered is correctly visible. If a sentence gets too long, break line. If the content is a bullet point, the linebreak should put the next line at the height of the text after the original bullet point. Images and external videos (external like youtube) need to be fitted correctly to size. Add support for LaTeX. Also think about integrating LaTeX into the editor.
The presenter should be able to start the presentation from the beginning or at the current page. The presenter should see a special screen with a big view of the current page and a small view of the next page right next to it. Below the next page preview I want a timer that shows the time passed since the presentation started. Add basic controls like pause time, reset time, continue time.
Also add a textmarker, a laserpointer and an eraser so the user can highlight specific elements on the page while presenting.
technologies: Think about the technologies used for implementing the features described to the best you can. This includes frontend design as well as backend design. Plan a thoughtful system architecture that is simple to deploy via a docker container (docker compose). The user experience is top priority. Use external libraries if needed but read the documentation first and understand which function calls really exist.
user_management:
Users should only create presentations when logged in. All data should be stored inside a sqlite. The data folder MUST be outside the webserver scope. (data not in public folder) Users can register and login. Think about the authentication process and security.
Think about common exploits and implement a strategy on how to circumvent these. User passwords must be stored hashed, no plain text passwords. The primary user ID should be stored as UUID for safety. The first user to register has special admin privileges. The admin should have a special admin page where they can do administrative work like resetting user passwords (only the admin can reset passwords), locking accounts (locked accounts cannot log in) and disabling the register feature so only existing users can log in. Secure fields agains attack vectors like sql or xss injections.
design: I uploaded our corporate design manual as well as all the assets like logos and banner (folder "cdhandbuch") into the project folder. Read the manual, understand it and use it while implementing the design.
docker: The port to access this application should be configured inside a .env file, as well as all other important settings.
